subject.title: fix: harden compaction and non-delivery replies

question: Should OpenClaw change `truncateAfterCompaction` from a documented opt-in setting to the default behavior for all existing configurations that omit it?
rationale: This is not only a local bug repair: it changes the effective behavior of existing persisted sessions on upgrade and the public configuration contract does not currently authorize that default change.

options.title: Keep rotation opt-in
options.body: Retain the current default and merge or rebase only the terminal non-delivery repair while pursuing the compaction-loop solution separately.

options.title: Approve the default change
options.body: Accept rotation by default only with aligned documentation and explicit fresh-install plus upgrade proof for existing sessions.

recommendation.title: Keep rotation opt-in
recommendation.body: Retain the current default and merge or rebase only the terminal non-delivery repair while pursuing the compaction-loop solution separately.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans embedded-run transcript lifecycle and auto-reply delivery behavior, and no individual current-main history owner could be established safely.
